State Life is procuring a secure, cloud-deployed corporate website and integrated customer self-service portal with one-year support. TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd brings a governance-and-security-first delivery model backed by ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certifications, plus CMMI Level 3 process maturity and PMP-certified project managers for disciplined execution and predictable outcomes. [CO-PROFILE]

Our differentiators for this assignment are:
1) Security by design for citizen/customer portals: We operate under an ISO 27001 information security framework and have delivered multiple cybersecurity programs (e.g., PKR 111M and PKR 15M engagements) that strengthen how we implement authentication, role-based access, and auditability—capabilities central to your portal requirements. [CO-PROFILE][CAP-025][CAP-001]
2) Proven delivery at scale and under public-sector expectations: We have delivered large technology programs for Federal and Provincial Government clients, including cloud infrastructure modernization (PKR 108M) that aligns with your requirement to deploy into State Life’s cloud environment. [CAP-012]
3) Transaction-grade digital experience foundation: Our mobile banking deployments (e.g., PKR 41M, PKR 121M, PKR 85M) demonstrate our ability to deliver secure customer-facing systems where reliability, data protection, and controlled user journeys are non-negotiable—directly relevant to premium payment and service-request flows. [CAP-035][CAP-023][CAP-011]

We also meet key commercial and compliance expectations: SECP incorporation, FBR NTN with Active Taxpayer (ATL) status, and the ability to arrange bid securities via scheduled banks up to our facility limits. [CO-PROFILE]

Our project library does not yet evidence a corporate website/CMS and policyholder self-service portal delivered as a single named reference; we will address this by proposing a dedicated UX/CMS delivery stream within the project team and by validating portal UX, accessibility approach, and content operations during inception before build. [CO-PROFILE]
